scope.principle: candidate chronology is preserved separately from qualified event time; timestamps remain wall-clock strings without assigned timezone

operating_workbook.interpretation: cumulative/corrected history and bank/rod snapshots; no August 2025 interval and no within-irradiation power interpolation supported

correspondence_candidate.qualification: correspondence statement; campaign candidate only; does not prove power/rod history, timezone semantics, or every specimen/monitor identity

maintained_schedule_candidate.phase1_rafm3: four per-sample 3-second windows on 2025-07-31, as enumerated rowwise
maintained_schedule_candidate.qualification: naive-time maintained metadata; disagrees with August 5 correspondence for RAFM4 phase2; no independent event log

native_count_chronology.timezone_semantics: none verified; do not auto-correct these deltas

ANS_header_evidence.limitation: empirical correspondence for this set only; not a vendor-verified ANS format or a timezone declaration

missing_qg_report.role: retain raw count identity; exclude from QG report-derived result/activity rows until report or alternate validated reduction is available

fe_cd_geometry.role: separate nominal near-contact report geometry; report label and structured distance field differ; exclude from nominal South 25 cm efficiency-domain match; campaign join unknown

source_findings.candidate_schedule_scope: 10 monitor rows exact-match maintained flux_wires base_name; Cu-Cd and Fe-Cd have no exact schedule row. Twenty specimen rows map by RAFM3 sample letter/timepoint or RAFM4 15d label to maintained schedule candidates. All schedule-to-physical-event joins remain unqualified.

Ti_4h_real_time.assumption: single Sc-48 exponential decay; uniform live fraction over reported real duration; diagnostic only, no measured-rate/input change

Ti_b_48h_real_time.assumption: single Sc-48 exponential decay; uniform live fraction over reported real duration; diagnostic only, no measured-rate/input change

diagnostics.use_limit: These are conditional illustrations using printed Sc-48 half-life and real-time durations; do not apply as corrected reported activities. No event-level flux or date-alternative Gaussian uncertainty was created.

observed_existing_gates: timezone-aware ordered start/end and EOI equality
full-duration power segments plus bound reactor-power and control-rod sources
local spectral-separability evidence when physical scalar history is requested
implementation_review.judgment: present discrepancy is missing/conflicting source chronology, not a reproduced code defect; existing fail-closed gates cover the missing inputs
